description: Nested field-group tabular arrays with many rows -- regression coverage for the larger per-row tape deficit (1 + 2*nested_group_count) in ParseNestedFieldGroupsArrayStrict.

tests.name: reallocates tape capacity for a tabular array with one nested field group and many rows
tests.note: One nested group (geo{lat,lon}) adds a deficit of 1+2*1=3 tape slots per row on top of the flat-tabular baseline.

tests.name: reallocates tape capacity for a tabular array with two nested field groups and many rows
tests.note: geo{point{lat,lon}} contains two FieldEntry::Nested groups (geo and point), for a deficit of 1+2*2=5 tape slots per row.
